newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Gold closes lower in Hong Kong on overseas selling.
newsitem.headline: Gold closes lower in Hong Kong on overseas selling.

text.p: Hong Kong gold closed lower on Wednesday after heavy speculative selling from overseas, extending the decline in New York overnight, dealers said.
Bullion ended at US$351.30/80 an ounce, down from New York's US$352.70/353.20 close on Tuesday and Hong Kong's previous close of US$353.00/50.

"Gold continued falling in the afternoon session in response to the U.S. dollar extending its rise to a fresh 46-month high of 118.50 against the yen," said a dealer at a local investment house. "But gold recovered and held at above US$350 where it found solid support."
Physical buying was said brisk at these levels.
Local gold ended HK$17 lower at HK$3,247 a tael.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society rose to -6.00 from its previous fix at -7.00.
